request.query: An iterative higher Hasse Schmidt derivation on a multivariate polynomial ring obeys additive formal group coaction and binomial coefficient composition rule

items.name: MvPolynomial.mkDerivation
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  (R : Type u_2) →
    {A : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] →
          [inst_2 : Module R A] →
            [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] →
              [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial σ R) A] → (σ → A) → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k l : ℕ),
  Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv
items.type:
(R : Type u_2) →
  {V : Type u_3} →
    [inst : AddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : Semiring R] → [inst_2 : Module R V] → ℕ → LaurentSeries V →ₗ[R] LaurentSeries V
